inputs.text: Organisers of the “No Kings” protests claim 8 million people attended more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, but authorities have provided no official count. That is a sizeable claim from the people promoting the demonstrations, not proof of a national consensus. Organisers say turnout was about one million higher, with 600 more events, than at the last demonstrations in October. Even so, noisy rallies are not a substitute for lawful authority or a mandate from the whole country. A nation cannot be governed by whichever political faction can organize the biggest protest.

subtopics: Claimed attendance and number of events
